note: The autonomous agent's real buy_cover transactions, as committed evidence. Every field here is re-checked against NEAR testnet by proof/verify.mjs and proof/agent-policy.mjs: the transaction signer must be agentAccount, the method must be buy_cover, the call must have succeeded, and the resulting policy's buyer, product, payout and premium must match. This file exists so the proof runs on a clean clone; the operator's local agent/audit.log.jsonl is gitignored and is not required.
